# neuron v0.1.2

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). The installer and portable ZIP include the tray app and CLI. The binaries are unsigned. Verify the download with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `SOURCE.txt` names the source commit and build method, and the installer and ZIP carry GitHub build-provenance attestations.

Verified on Windows with a Naga V2 Pro, BlackWidow Chroma V2, and Chroma games. Other platforms remain unverified.

Neuron spends most of its life in the tray, so idle cost matters. I kept catching it doing work while nothing was happening and followed those wakes through the input, audio, rendering, macro, and UI paths. v0.1.2 keeps the mechanics intact, makes the client much quieter, and fixes the reliability problems that profiling shook loose.

## Changed

- Reduced idle work across dispatch, capture, audio, gestures, tray handling, previews, and Python macros. Macro workers start on demand without dropping the first action.
- Tightened Razer reply validation and write read-back. Fixed BlackWidow brightness control, intercepted-key release, and sniper DPI restoration on the correct mouse.
- Serialized profile changes, migration, and recovery. Safe mode disarms input and pauses device writes; Windows startup now runs at normal user privilege while native Chroma is installed and maintained behind a protected broker.
- Improved renderer selection and fallback, with opt-in WGPU and OpenGL kept as the measured lower-cost default. Bounded integration clients, corrected Chroma RGB decoding, and hardened OBS input.
